theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_c1pt_fderiv_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (a : Euclid n) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → a ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ g a → (∀ x ∈ U, m * ‖x - a‖ ≤ ‖g x - g a‖) → ∀ v : Euclid n, m * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g a v‖
